candidate_excerpts.text: The General Dynamics FB-111 was SAC’s medium-range bomber, capable of flying supersonic speeds at 200 feet above the ground and twice the speed of sound above 35,000 feet. It was the strategic/theater bomber version of the F-111 multi-purpose aircraft. It was meant to supplement the B-52 fleet after the retirement of the B-58 Hustler and until the B-1 could be put into production.
